errors.text: The phase-transition rationale is internally inconsistent: milling strain is said to lower the barrier for an FCC-to-BCC transition, but the same milled state is also said to stabilize FCC through strain energy.
The asserted Ti-driven HCP precipitation threshold above 1050°C is not supported by the cited evidence, which primarily concerns Nb-, V-, or Al-containing analogues rather than CoCrFeNiTi.

Low-load Vickers testing alone cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening; quantitative grain-size and phase-fraction correlations or matched microstructural controls are required.
